TANK.name: Tank
TANK.ultimateDescribe: Every {{cadence}} actions, instead of attacking, grants every ally a shield worth {{value}}% of their max HP.

SUPPORT.name: Support
SUPPORT.ultimateDescribe: Every {{cadence}} actions, instead of attacking, heals every ally for {{value}}% of their max HP.

FIGHTER.name: Fighter
FIGHTER.ultimateDescribe: Every {{cadence}} actions, lands a single blow for {{value}}% of its damage.

BALANCED.name: Balanced
BALANCED.ultimateDescribe: Every {{cadence}} actions, lands a single blow for {{value}}% of its damage.

RANGER.name: Ranger
RANGER.ultimateDescribe: Every {{cadence}} actions, hits two enemies for {{value}}% of its damage.

ASSASSIN.name: Assassin
ASSASSIN.ultimateDescribe: Every {{cadence}} actions, hits the same target twice for {{value}}% of its damage.

MAGE.name: Mage
MAGE.ultimateDescribe: Every {{cadence}} actions, hits every enemy for {{value}}% of its damage.
